item.title: Dodgers Roster: Ryan Fitzgerald Clears Waivers & Sent Outright To Triple-A Oklahoma City
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers sent Ryan Fitzgerald outright to Triple-A Oklahoma City after he cleared waivers. Fitzgerald was claimed off waivers from the Minnesota Twins earlier this month before getting designated for assignment to make room on the 40-man roster for Andy Ibáñez, who signed a one-year contract with the Dodgers worth $1.2 million.
